title: Ilhan Omar raid concerns immigration paperwork from when she was a child, sources say
summary: Federal agents searched Rep. Ilhan Omar's Washington, D.C., home Monday morning. Sources tell CBS News a yearslong probe into Omar involves immigration paperwork that was completed by her late father when she was a child. Omar, a U.S. citizen, and the first Somali American in Congress, called the search "an attempt to target political enemies." Nicole Sgang…
